summary: The global marketing team is executing a China-first strategy, prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China for search/AI visibility while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and managing urgent operational and event deadlines.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the China-first program push: Asia Star and the new Intelligent China are the lead initiatives, with US partner programs on hold and Berkeley a possible third. This week, the team must launch the Intelligent China webpage and drive traffic, analyze Asia Star participant profiles and CRM hot leads, and audit Google Ads conversion tracking to support visibility. The knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team favored the current design with menu categorization changes, inspired by Joseph's editorial layout, and will remove the standalone videos section, disperse videos by topic, and add the BCI banner to the homepage. Urgent operational items include resolving an Outlook account lockout by updating passwords across all devices and contacting JSB to confirm backend unlock. Looking ahead, the team must align on the Nov 13 EuroCham Shanghai APEC event, where Prof. Tao has accepted an invitation to speak, and respond to Yili Group's digitalization custom program enquiry, while ESG report drafts and the AACSB 2027 Global Impact Award application are also in motion.

decisions.text: All devices must update to the new password to avoid repeated account lockouts
Remove the standalone videos section and disperse videos by topic across the site.
Keep the current knowledge design largely as-is, with menu categorization as the main change.
Bring the BCI banner (and BSI) into the knowledge section homepage.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Use Joseph's editorial-style layout as inspiration to display more articles, not to be followed exactly.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs; US partner programs (Stanford, Columbia) on hold initially.
Berkeley program to be considered as a possible third priority and included in the audit phase.
Prof. Tao accepted invitation to speak at the Nov 13 CKGSB x EuroCham Shanghai APEC event
